verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-retention settings, retention periods, or deletion controls for execution data, logs, or stored user data. The closest items are adjacent features: deleting a scenario, deleting AI Agents through the API, and viewing or modifying data stores through MCP. These are entity-management operations, not retention or deletion controls over data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
